subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Aurora Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorasystems.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@aurorasystems.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Aurora Systems

Hi Samir / Laura,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap from my side and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Real-time recommendations for customer support routing (low latency requirement, 95th pct target < 200ms)
- Sensitive PII in transcripts; needs VPC/on-prem or strong KMS controls
- High daily throughput during peak windows (expected 300k tokens/day)

What Redwood can help with
- Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed KMS + audit logs for compliance
- Dedicated capacity pool for predictable latency and throughput; autoscaling for peak windows
- Prefix caching to reduce per-token cost on repeated prompts

Proposed pilot (low-risk)
1) 4-week evaluation: ingest a representative subset (~2 weeks of transcripts) into a sandbox VPC + run a 2-model comparison (open model + quantized variant)
2) Redwood provides a mutual action plan and an initial Dedicated capacity config; Aurora provides sample data access and a short security questionnaire response
3) Goal: validate latency, cost/unit, and output quality to surface next steps for production rollout

Ask / next steps
- Can you confirm whether security prefers VPC or on-prem for the pilot?
- Do you have a preferred window for a 30-min kickoff next week (I have Tue/Wed morning PST open)?
- I attached a quick MutualActionPlan.xlsx + our product one-pager for reference.

Attachments: MutualActionPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Prod_one-pager.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up to walk through the MAP.

Best,

Hi Samir / Laura,

Wanted to check one more time on timing and fit. I realize your team is balancing priorities right now, so a quick ask: could you let me know which of the following makes most sense for Aurora?

A) Proceed: Book a 30-min kickoff next week to finalize MAP and get a sandbox VPC set up (I can send calendar options).
B) Feedback first: If the proposed pilot doesn’t look like a fit, a sentence or two on the blocker helps us avoid wasting your time.
C) Hold: If now isn’t the right timing, tell me to pause and I’ll check back in a month.

If helpful, I can also share a short anonymized latency/cost example from a recent customer in your space to make the tradeoffs concrete.

Appreciate any quick direction — even a one-line reply works.
